description: Synthetic Underground Hydrogen Storage Measurement, Reporting and Verification Dataset (SUHS-MRV) is a data set described in the paper "Synthetic Underground Hydrogen Storage Measurement, Reporting and Verification Dataset (SUHS-MRV)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Sreekanth Muktevi, Yogesh Nagpal, Rajesh Leela and colleagues. This article presents the synthetic underground hydrogen storage (UHS) measurement, reporting, and verification dataset (SUHS-MRV), a synthetic, rule-based dataset developed to support early-stage MRV workflows for UHS. The dataset simulates cyclic hydrogen injection, withdrawal, losses, cushion-gas behavior, methane coproduction, and compression energy across three reservoir types: salt caverns, depleted gas reservoirs, and aquifers. Coverage: synthetic underground hydrogen storage sites. The data are held on Zenodo, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support underground hydrogen storage monitoring and reporting workflows. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
